name: sandcastle
description: The judgement half of a @c-energie/sandcastle-harness install — the half that has already gone wrong once — in three skills: getting a workspace wired and verified in order, token-free until the image build; writing or repairing the implementer, reviewer, group-reviewer, revision and planner briefs from that project's own governing documents rather than from a guess; and getting a backlog ready for --epic, whose plan obeys native GitHub links and nothing written in issue text.
